## 2023 Honda Odyssey Features

If you're someone who's after a reliable minivan with lots of standard amenities, safety features, and an efficient powertrain, then the 2023 Honda Odyssey is likely the vehicle for you. It has a 3.5-liter V6 making 280 horsepower, standard 18-inch alloy wheels, LED headlights, heated front seats, and much more. For 2023, Honda has introduced a new mid-range Sport model to the lineup.

It brings unique 19-inch wheels, gloss black exterior accents, black leather upholstery with red stitching, as well as red ambient interior lighting. Meanwhile, Honda has discontinued the previous LX base model, leaving the EX as the new entry-level trim. Also, every 2023 Honda Odyssey now comes with free maintenance for over two years or 24,000 miles. The 2023 Honda Odyssey is offered in five trims: EX, EX-L, Sport, Touring, and Elite.

Keep reading to discover more about this family-friendly minivan, then take a test drive at Westshore Honda in Tampa, FL, to determine if this vehicle is right for you.

## Comfortable & Relaxing Driving Dynamics

Every 2023 Honda Odyssey features a 3.5-liter V6 that generates 280 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque. This engine is paired with a reliably efficient 10-speed automatic transmission that only sends power to the front wheels, as all-wheel drive is unavailable. EPA-estimated fuel economy rating for the 2023 Odyssey is 19 mpg in the city and 28 mpg on the highway.

This minivan is rated to tow up to 3,500 pounds.

![Image 8: 2023 Honda Odyssey Specs & Features slider1](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cka-dash/210-1022-WHO1166/slider1.jpg)

![Image 9: 2023 Honda Odyssey Specs & Features slider2](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cka-dash/210-1022-WHO1166/slider2.jpg)

![Image 10: 2023 Honda Odyssey Specs & Features slider3](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cka-dash/210-1022-WHO1166/slider3.jpg)

![Image 11: 2023 Honda Odyssey Specs & Features slider4](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cka-dash/210-1022-WHO1166/slider4.jpg)

## Well-Appointed Cabin

Inside, the 2023 Honda Odyssey is richly-appointed, offering almost everything modern families need. The base EX trim has cloth upholstery, heated and power-adjustable front seats, power-sliding rear doors, Honda's Magic Slide second-row seats, tri-zone automatic climate control, and second-row sunshades. The EX-L elevates the experience to luxury with standard leather upholstery, driver's seat memory settings, a moonroof, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and a power liftgate.

Those who want to stand out can opt for the mid-range Sport trim, which distinguishes itself with red interior LED lighting and black leather upholstery with red stitching. The Touring model enhances the experience with even more tech. If you're after even more luxury features, the top-level Elite might be just what you need. It adds standard heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, sound-reducing side and rear window glass, and a hands-free tailgate.

In terms of cargo space, the 2023 Odyssey is just as impressive. It has 32.8 to 38.6 cubic feet of cargo volume with all seats upright, 86.6 and 92.3 cubes with the rearmost seats folded down, and between 140.7 and 158 cubic feet with the third and second rows folded. These figures vary based on the model you choose.

Outside, the 2023 Odyssey features LED headlights, 18-inch alloy wheels, heated mirrors, available 19-inch wheels, automatic wipers, power-folding and auto-dimming side mirrors, etc.

## Intuitive Infotainment System

The 2023 Honda Odyssey comes standard with a straightforward 8-inch touchscreen, Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™ capability, two USB ports, satellite radio, HD Radio, Bluetooth, and a seven-speaker audio system. Upper trims offer a Wi-Fi hotspot, a rear-seat entertainment system, wireless device charging, navigation, an 11-speaker premium audio system, and additional USB ports.

![Image 12: 2023 Honda Odyssey Specs & Features interiorimage](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cka-dash/210-1022-WHO1166/interiorimage.jpg)

## Advanced Safety Technologies

The 2023 Odyssey is outfitted with the Honda Sensing safety suite. It includes forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane-departure warning, lane-keeping assistance, pedestrian detection, and adaptive cruise control with low-speed follow.

Other safety systems include a rearview camera, traffic sign recognition, rear cross-traffic alert, rear-seat alert, and automatic high-beam headlights. Front and rear parking sensors and rain-sensing windshield wipers are optional.

**2023 Honda models – horsepower & cargo volume (Kelley Blue Book)**  

| Model | Horsepower (hp) | Cargo volume (cu ft.) | Horsepower ÷ Cargo volume (hp/ft³) |
|-------|-----------------|------------------------|------------------------------------|

| **Honda HR‑V** | 158 hp【2】 | 55.1 cu ft【2】 | 158 ÷ 55.1 ≈ **2.87** |
| **Honda Odyssey** | 280 hp【3】 | 32.8 cu ft【3】 | 280 ÷ 32.8 ≈ **8.54** |

**Which has the lowest horsepower‑to‑volume ratio?**  
The 2023 Honda CR‑V has the lowest ratio (≈ 2.48 hp/ft³), followed by the HR‑V (≈ 2.87 hp/ft³) and the Odyssey (≈ 8.54 hp/ft³). Therefore, the CR‑V is the most “efficient” in terms of power relative to cargo space among these three 2023 Honda models.
